content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm unable to find a mobile-compatible device to replace my current modem. Could someone advise what device I can use as a substitute? I have programmed an alarm system at my home and I want the system to send notifications to my mobile device, so that I can be informed of alarms even when I'm not at home. Thank you. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a suitable replacement for their current modem in order to receive alarm notifications remotely on their mobile device. The main issue appears to be a lack of clear information regarding [company_name]'s solutions for enabling remote alarm communication in home automation setups.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to identify a device compatible with [company_name] products that can replace the modem and allow remote alarm notifications to their mobile device.
